name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 7 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-05-07, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
